messages:
Maria (AE): Quick sync — ACME bank requested an on-prem POC in a closed network. They need signed install bundles, offline bootstrap, a 30–90 day POC window, and no external telemetry. Who can confirm feasibility and give a rough price/ops plan? :eyes:
Sam (SE): We can support signed bundles + offline bootstrap. Need clarity on HSM/KMS (customer-managed vs our soft KMS) and whether they allow a jumpbox for updates. Also what's max bundle size? :+1:
Maria (AE): They specified <=5GB per node images, no internet egress, USB transfer allowed, and only one 4-hour maintenance window per month. They referenced security questionnaire SQA-112 and an internal compliance form SQA-119.
Deepa (Eng Platform): Feasible. We deliver a signed tarball + detached signature and a signed manifest for deltas. Offline delta updates require us to maintain a patch lineage; we can provide chained signed manifests that the bootstrap verifies. For monthly windows we can stagger node updates to meet SLAs. Example bootstrap command we provide:
```
sh install.sh --offline --bundle offline-bundle-v1.2.tar.gz --verify ./bundle.sig
```
Sam (SE): Heads up: model artifacts (quantized weights) can push bundles >5GB. Recommend model-side pruning or splitting model from runtime if they insist on the 5GB cap. Also we should pin model and runtime versions for the POC; KV cache migration should be disabled during acceptance tests.
Chris (Security): A few blockers from SQA-112: telemetry must be off by default and opt-in only, we need customer-managed keys (PKCS#11/HSM preferred), and full audit logs retained for 90 days. Please confirm if the customer will provide an HSM or needs our HSM integration package. Also request FIPS/CC info from infra.
Andrew (Sales Ops): Pricing: standard POC license (30 days) is complimentary. Engineering packaging & signing fee: $7,500 one-time. Offline support add-on for POC (dedicated oncall + airgap support) $2,000/month. If they want extended patching guarantees add $1,500/month. I'll draft an addendum — need the billing contact.
Maria (AE): Billing contact is rachel.finance@acme.com. They also asked whether we can commit to a monthly upgrade cadence in contract — are we comfortable?
Deepa (Eng Platform): For GA we support configurable cadence; monthly is our recommended default for security patches. Major model upgrades should be scheduled out-of-band with longer testing windows. We can offer SLA language for monthly security patch windows; major releases are explicitly excluded unless contracted.
Sam (SE): Ops runbook notes: we'll supply a rollback procedure based on immutable image snapshot + config restore. Rollback steps are quick (reboot to previous image, restore config). We'll include smoke tests to validate post-upgrade: /health, small inference run (sample prompt), and image checksum verification.
Maria (AE): Can someone prepare a 1-pager (technical checklist + acceptance criteria + list of deliverables) by EOD PST so I can send to ACME before Thu call? :pray:
Deepa (Eng Platform): I'll push a draft checklist to the repo and post link here when ready. deploy-bot: New artifact uploaded: offline-bundle-v1.2.tar.gz (sha256: abc123def4567890...).
Chris (Security): I'll start SQA-112 answers. Need confirmation from ACME on HSM vs software KMS and whether they require mutual TLS for inter-service comms.
Andrew (Sales Ops): I'll attach the pricing addendum to the SOW template and loop legal if they request enterprise terms.
Maria (AE): Thanks team — setting a call with ACME for Thu 10am PT. If anything becomes a hard blocker before then, flag it here so I can escalate. :thumbsup:
